posts.name: pwatson1974
posts.cooked:
Freedom Five #801: Itsy Bitsy Spider Bots

 

Megalopolis has seen better days. Quite a few of them. Although the city survived the rampage of OblivAeon, it hasn't escaped unscathed. The area around Freedom Tower, more accurately where Freedom Tower used to be, took the heaviest beating but the rest of the city wasn't left untouched by the cosmic entity.

The government science teams are still picking through the wreckage, searching for anything that might have survived. Still wearing radiation suits against any lingering radiation, they're poring over the rubble.

Over your radios, you hear firefighter chatter as they deal with a still burning building on 5th Street, ambulances wailing as they head to 7th where a family has been pulled from the wreckage.

Still, despite this, the city remains as it always has, locals helping out, digging through shattered homes for survivors, arriving on scene with hot food for the rescue workers and firefighters, or meeting under the titanic boughs of Akash'Flora in what used to be Freedom Park and is now a city block-sized tree that other scientist teams are trying to understand.

RevoCorp has even sent the leader of their new team, the Paradigms, to help. She's due in today and it will be good to meet up with your old intern.

 

So, heroes, what are you doing?

Having made his way to the fire on 5th Absolute Zero heads into the building. He triggers the opening of the aperture on his left hand and with a sharp intake of breath, a beam of cold energy shoots from his hand and puts out some of the smaller fires. Ryan giving his suit a chance to warm up before tackling the larger blaze. 

In the apparent solitude of the burning building, Ryan asks over the coms "Meredith did you manage to clear out any of the civilians on 5th. Don't want to have any unseen surprises." 

Cycling his coms to a more public frequency. "Cheif Jenkerson do we have any idea of the integrity of this building? Are we looking to save the building or just not let it spread?"

posts.cooked:
"Your help is always appreciated Paul. If this doesn't go to plan I may need you to keep people clear of any debris." 

With a few quick finger taps on his suits internal sensor array to do a sharp sudden exposure of Absolute Zero's forearms to allow for rapid fire suppression. 

( Overcome using the Principle of Cold, Green Dice, Creativity :  5 Minor twist: Take min dice damage 2 ) 

With a blast of cold, the fire flares once and dies. However with his focus on the fire, Absolute Zero misses on key structural weakness in the floor beneath him. With the sudden shift in temperature, the weakness caused by the fire expands and the floor collapsing under him. 

When the noise stops you hear over the coms "Well that was unpleasant"

posts.name: MindWanderer
posts.cooked:
Unity turns the corner of 8th and Grant, riding on an saurian robot.  "Whoo!  Sorry I'm late, guys.  GPS is wonky and Mr. Chomps got lost."

"Mr. Chomps" does not resemble any previous incarnation of Raptor Bot, apparently being made out of some mismatched car parts and a broken manhole cover, but it's in the same ballpark.  It steps in a sodden piece of ground and gets stuck.  Unity simply hops off and lets the bot disintegrate.

"Hi, Doc!  Good to see ya again!  Wow, what a mess, huh?  You got this one figured out yet?"

While she's talking and without waiting for a reply, Unity assembles a golem that resembles a centaur/ant with a dump truck for a back, with multiple limbs for assisting in multiple types of repair work.  (Spawn Golem: 4 Robotics, 3 Creativity, 10 Status, mid=4 for a d8 Boost Bot.)

posts.name: Phantom5613
posts.cooked:
"Frost, you alright?" asks Vance over the coms. "Sounds like you may have had a bit of trouble over there." The Bunker suit walks along whatever is the clearest path, which just so happens to be along the sidewalk at the moment. Realizing how long it will take him to get to the freeway on foot, he spots a large and empty flatbed truck just finishing dropping off suplies to a work crew. "Excuse me," he asks the driver, the suit kneeling down a few feet away from the drivers seat. "If you don't mind sparing fifteen minutes, could I ask for a lift?"

(Overcome to persuade driver to let Bunker catch a ride: Intuition=1, Self Dicipline=5, Status=8; Mid=5)

"Wow, it's Bunker!" the worker exclaims happily, her head leaning out the window, throwing a thumb towards the back of the truck. "You need a lift, I'm your gal! Hop on! You saved my brother's whole unit overseas a few years ago!"

"Glad to be of assistance, ma'am. And thank you." The large metal suit steps onto the truck's flatbed, a loud-SNAP!-heard as it take's Bunker's full weight. Inside the large metal chassi Vance sighs. "Uh-oh..." the driver says. "I think you just killed the suspension."

"Sorry about that. Have your company send the repair bills to the Freedom Five. We'll cover them." With a nod the driver starts the engine up, driving carefully down the street.

posts.name: pwatson1974
posts.cooked:
As Tachyon turns to greet her former intern, the manhole she was investigating clatters open, spilling out half a dozen mailbox sized metallic creatures. Four spindly legs scrabble on the tarmac as they turn unblinking red eyes toward the two heroes. Mandibles clack ominously as they advacne in waves of three.

On trio turns towards Tachyon. The one at hte back clamps its mandibles onto the manhole cover, cutting it in half and plugging the severed metal pieces into the robot ahead of it (Boost Roll 3 for +1). Aided by the influx of metal it opens a small port above its eye and fires a mesh of steel filaments at Tachyon, wrapping around one leg and making it harder to move (Hinder Roll 1+1 for boost and +1 for webbing for -1 penalty to Tachyon’s actions). The final member of the trio scuttles forward, raising its mandables and clamping down on her arm (Attack roll 6, 6 damage).

The others turn their attention to Unity. The first begins chewing on a nearby car to boost its fellow (Boost Roll 4 for +2). Its ally hurls the webbing, wrapping around Unity and Mr Chomps, binding them together as Mr Chomps falls to the ground in the mesh (Hinder Roll 6+2 Boost +1 webs for -3 penalty to Unity). The third advances, mandables biting into Unity’s shoulder (Attack Roll 5 for 5 damage).
